Frequently Asked Questions
Where is GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA located?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA is located in Baksa, Assam. Address: Chanbarikhuti,Barimukh ,Mushalpur.
What type of institution is GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA is classified as a "Affiliated College" under State Government management.
How many other colleges are in Baksa?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA is one of 15 colleges in Baksa district, and one of 692 in Assam overall.
When was GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA established?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA was established in 2023.
What courses does GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA offer?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA offers 7 programs across 1 level (Under Graduate), spanning Assamese, Education, English, Other Indian Languages, Economics, History, Political Science.

Across all listed programs, GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA has a combined approved intake of 322 students per year, as per AISHE data.
What disciplines are offered at GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA?
GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA offers programmes in the following disciplines: Assamese, Education, English, Bodo, Economics, History, Political Science.
What programs are offered at GOVERNMENT MODEL COLLEGE, BAKSA?
